Prices for the stay of Nov 3 to 5, 2026, as listed on September 29, 2026.

18 Rio de Janeiro hotels, each priced on every booking site we recorded for it. Prices on this page are per night, all-in where the sites reported taxes and fees; the study's count below uses the before-tax prices of its CSV. The going rate is the price the largest number of listings that named a room or offered free cancellation agreed on (ties go to the lower price).

One snapshot on September 29, 2026 for Nov 3 to Nov 5, 2 adults, US market, USD. Prices change daily.

Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Rio de Janeiro hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 29, 2026 snapshot, at 17 of the 18 Rio de Janeiro hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 6, HomeToGo at 2, Vio.com at 2, Billabook.com at 1, BusinessHotels.com at 1, Catchit.com at 1, Reserving at 1, the hotel's own site at 1 and 2 other sites at 2 between them. These are the Rio de Janeiro rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

Taxes and fees at Rio de Janeiro hotels

At the 11 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 5% ($11 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 4% at Windsor Hotel to 5% at PortoBay Rio Internacional. At 7 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
